title.en: Member loads follow the final member frame
title.es: Las cargas siguen el sistema final del miembro
title.pt: As cargas seguem o sistema final do membro
title.fr: Les charges suivent le repère final de la barre
title.tr: Eleman yükleri son eleman eksenlerini izler

explanation.en: Corotational 2D/3D and planar path solvers now rotate dead mechanical fixed-end forces and moments from reference coordinates before combining them with elastic end actions. Thermal eigenstrain actions stay in the current member frame; public nonlinear thermal refusals are unchanged. Re-check member forces under mechanical member loads when the chord or spatial frame rotates (#1952; SA-2026-061).
explanation.es: Los solvers corrotacionales 2D/3D y de trayectoria plana transforman fuerzas y momentos de empotramiento al sistema final antes de sumarlos a las acciones elásticas. Revisá los esfuerzos bajo cargas de miembro cuando gira su cuerda o sistema espacial (#1952; SA-2026-061).
explanation.pt: Os solvers corrotacionais 2D/3D e de trajetória plana transformam forças e momentos de engastamento para o sistema final antes de combiná-los com as ações elásticas. Revise os esforços sob cargas de membro quando sua corda ou sistema espacial gira (#1952; SA-2026-061).
explanation.de: Korotationale 2D/3D- und ebene Pfadlöser transformieren Einspannkräfte und -momente vor der Kombination mit elastischen Endkräften in das endgültige Stabkoordinatensystem. Stabkräfte bei gedrehter Sehne oder räumlichem System erneut prüfen (#1952; SA-2026-061).
explanation.fr: Les solveurs corotationnels 2D/3D et de cheminement plan transforment les efforts et moments d’encastrement dans le repère final avant de les combiner aux actions élastiques. Revérifiez les efforts sous charges de barre lorsque sa corde ou son repère spatial tourne (#1952 ; SA-2026-061).
explanation.tr: Eş dönel 2B/3B ve düzlemsel yol çözücüleri, ankastrelik kuvvetlerini ve momentlerini elastik uç etkileriyle birleştirmeden önce son eleman eksenlerine dönüştürür. Kiriş doğrultusu veya uzaysal eksenleri döndüğünde eleman yükleri altındaki kuvvetleri yeniden denetleyin (#1952; SA-2026-061).
